tool_input.description: 列出Nacos数据库配置字段名
tool_input.command:
$form = 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}'
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $form -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$auth = $login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
$token = [string]$auth.accessToken
$url = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?dataId=shared-druid-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$text = [string](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content
foreach ($line in ($text -split "`r?`n")) { $m = [regex]::Match($line, '^(\s*)([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\s*:'); if ($m.Success) { 'indent=' + $m.Groups[1].Length + ' key=' + $m.Groups[2].Value } }
